[EN] An Alliance of Malevolence
[ES] Una alianza de malevolencia
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please help Liyaqat!
[ES] ¡Por favor, ayuda a Liyaqat!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Nagas and gulas. This could hardly get worse.
[ES] Nagas y gulas. Esto difícilmente podría empeorar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the gulas.
[ES] Encuentra a los gulas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] See Centurion Liyaqat at the Ecdysi Atrium in the Temple of Dagon.
[ES] Busca al centurión Liyaqat en Ecdysi Atrium en el Temple of Dagon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Proof of Alliance
[ES] Prueba de la alianza
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt besharan smugglers and slaves near the Coiling Transepts, and find the proof of the alliance.
[ES] Caza contrabandistas y esclavos besharan cerca de Coiling Transepts y encuentra la prueba de la alianza.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the proof of alliance to Liyaqat at the Ecdysi Atrium.
[ES] Lleva la prueba de la alianza a Liyaqat en Ecdysi Atrium.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
